subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
topic: Principle of operation of gyro magnetic compass system.
syllabus_extract: Principle of operation of gyro magnetic compass system.
specific_objectives: 15.1.12.4 Trainee will be able to explain gyro magnetic compass system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Gyro Magnetic Compass alignment procedure; Safety: Ensure electrical isolation before handling; Supervision: Instructor monitors alignment steps.
intro_questions: What are the two fundamental properties of a gyroscope?
Why is a magnetic compass unreliable near the poles?
How does the gyro magnetic compass differ from a standard magnetic compass?

development.content:
Gyroscopic properties in navigation
Need for gyro magnetic compass
Sensing element and torque motor
Control system and damping mechanism
Alignment with magnetic north

Error correction mechanisms
Latitude error compensation
Speed error compensation
Automatic alignment process
System monitoring indicators

Operational limitations
Power failure effects
Maintenance requirements
Troubleshooting common faults
Integration with flight instruments

summary_questions: Explain how the gyro magnetic compass corrects for latitude error.
Describe the role of the torque motor in the system.
What happens to the compass indication during a power failure?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between the gyro magnetic compass and the directional gyro, focusing on their respective roles in LP 02.
